title: Book Dune Cottage | 5-Bed 3.5-Bath Rosemary Beach Cottage | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: A spacious 5-bed, 3.5-bath Rosemary Beach cottage with room for 12 guests, Dune Cottage boasts all the charming features and amenities you could ask for—see it here!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Offering the finest in Southern hospitality, Dune's Cottage is a unique Rosemary Beach gem. This family sized home was designed on a grand scale with space enough for sixteen to spread out comfortably. Located on prestigious Rosemary Avenue, convenient to everything, Dune's Cottage is located only 60 yards from the beach.

From the outside, Dune's Cottage exudes antebellum charm with its pillared veranda, multiple French doors that lead to full, wrap-around terraces and an intimate courtyard with Moroccan inspired heated and jetted dipping pool.

This is a home on a grand scale with the highest quality finishes, oversized rooms and high ceilings. Inside, the professionally decorated rooms combine the best of traditional charm with contemporary, beach chic. Custom, high-end furnishings and original artwork create a standard rarely seen in a vacation home that still manages to be very family friendly. Dune's Cottage offers multiple gathering spaces; whether around the kitchen island, the dining table with seating for 12, or the enormous great room accented with wooden beams and a 14 foot limestone fireplace.

There are also no shortage of quiet, outdoor spaces for guests to spread out, all lit by the warm glow of ten gas lanterns. There is a lavishly furnished 40 foot wide upper porch that functions as an outdoor living room, a private courtyard with glass tiled waterfall dipping pool and grill. The ground level boasts another furnished wrap around stone terrace accented with a bubbling fountain. Recently added is a dramatic, rear sky deck accessed by a spiral staircase, with retractable shade awning and seating for six, that provides panoramic views of Rosemary Beach and the gulf.

Dunes cottage was thoughtfully laid out specifically for the perfect beach vacation. It has four well-appointed guestrooms on the ground level each with its own television and DVD player. These are laid out to function as two separate family suites, each with an oversized, slate and tumbled marble bathroom. One of the two, large bunk rooms can also function as a theater/den with its 44 inch flat screen television and play station that will keep the kids happy. The lofty, open main living area with another large screen TV, board games and extensive DVD library, make up the entire second floor, which also boasts a convenient second entrance with exterior staircase that leads directly down to the beach boardwalk access. The custom kitchen is a cook's dream that includes a professional range, separate ice maker and even a wall mounted "pot filler". The entire third floor contains a luxury master suite, complete with a private balcony, dressing room and enormous bathroom with "rain" shower and jetted tub.

Garage parking for one vehicle.

Nothing has been forgotten in Dunes' Cottage. You will see why families and large groups return every summer to this home for an unforgettable beach vacation. Book Dune Carriage House for additional space.

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER, THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS - SATURDAY TO SATURDAY

Pool heated October 1st through May 1st for additional charge
